pages.title: Final Warning
pages.text: The world is vast, and its spirit beasts are countless. A beast's cultivation realm alone does not determine its danger. Bloodline, innate abilities, and terrain may decide the outcome of an encounter. A wise cultivator knows not only when to fight, but when to retreat.
